title: India annual-report text-change PILOT (pre-registered; 200 non-financial NSE firms Rs500-20,000 cr, FY22->FY23 & FY23->FY24, sector-size controls): MD&A changers -2.1% (wins -4.1%, t -0.30), auditor+CARO changers -0.8% (t -0.12), new auditor-section adverse items (21 hand-confirmed) +7.7% (median +17.5%) at 12m = NO-GO; changers did BETTER than other sample firms (+2 to +6 pp)
body: Pre-registered in research_notes/Backtests/india_annual_report_text.md s0 before sampling. Frame = 2,021 NSE symbols with an announcement Jun-Sep 2023 (survivorship-free for mid-2023 listings), seed 2026112203; 810 walked -> 350 eligible (200 text firms + 150 control-only). 585 ARs (5.1 GB, median 6.9 MB) downloaded via new `nse_fetch.py annual_reports`, pdftotext'd, PDFs deleted; section parser usable for 77% (MD&A) / 83% (auditor+CARO) of pairs; BRSR pages excluded by construction. Go rule (wins. mean <= -5%, median < 0, t <= -1.5; H3: >=10 flags, wins <= -10%) failed on all three. Calibration: all text-firm events -4.0/-6.6% vs controls (sample noise), so read relative: changers +1.9 pp (MD&A) / +5.8 pp (auditor) vs all events. Lottery profile as US (medians -17%/-10%, hit 37-42%). Secondary only: stalest auditor text (Q5) -15.2% (t -2.54) but P1 -28.5% / P2 -2.0% -> hypothesis, not finding. Auditor-change cases: 'trouble' items (restatement, qualification, regulatory/tax action, default) median -10% but mean +3%; technical EoMs (schemes, mergers, policy changes) carry no signal. Use: judgment cue in stage-4 deep dives (diff auditor report + CARO vs prior year), not a rule.

title: Text-change flag (status after US v1, US v2 and the Indian AR pilot, 2026-11-23): RETIRED as a mechanical rule in the US and India (India pilot: MD&A/auditor changers no worse than peers; NO-GO for a full run). Keep only stage-4 judgment cues: first 10-K after de-SPAC = look harder; in Indian ARs, diff the auditor's report + CARO vs last year (new qualification / restatement / regulatory EoM = look harder)
body: Evidence: insight:bt-lazy-prices-us-2021-23, insight:bt-lazy-prices-us-v2-2024-25, insight:bt-india-annual-report-text-pilot-fy23-24. India pilot pre-registered; 200 firms, 2 pair-years; H1 MD&A -2.1% t -0.30, H2 auditor -0.8% t -0.12, H3 auditor-change flags +7.7%. Open hypothesis only: stale auditor text (Q5) -15% in 2023-24, not in 2024-25.

title: 2026-11-23: NO full multi-year Indian annual-report text-change backtest (pilot failed its pre-registered go rule on all three tests); keep the AR fetcher + section parser + auditor diff for stage-4 deep dives
body: Pre-stated rule: GO if bottom-quintile wins. mean <= -5% AND median < 0 AND t <= -1.5 (H1 or H2), or >= 10 confirmed auditor flags with wins. mean <= -10% and median < 0 (H3), plus >= 75% usable pairs. Feasibility passed (77%/83%), effects did not (-4.1%/t -0.30, -3.7%/t -0.12, +4.8%). Tools: tools/nse_fetch.py annual_reports; tools/backtests/india_ar_text/{sections,flags}.py.

data.reopen_if: a fresh-data test of the 'stale auditor text' hypothesis is pre-registered, or a cheaper section-level signal (e.g. new auditor qualifications across all NSE firms) is proposed
